## Summary

- **The real GitHub Issues adapter** — `crates/hh-github-issues` is the
  packaged `work_source_adapter/1.0` variant
  (`plugins/hh-github-issues/plugin.manifest.json`,
  `subprocess_confined`, records-in/records-out, no egress/env grants):
  `capabilities`/`occurrences`/`suspended`/`activate_run`/`list`/`get`
  over the `hh.fleet.github_source/1` doc. `GithubTracker`
  (`hh-fleet-adapter/src/github.rs`) is the `TrackerLogic`; issue JSON
  normalizes via the shared dialect (`native_id` = the issue number;
  `pull_request` rows excluded from the issue lane).
- **Raw-body signed ingress** — `hh-fleet/src/github.rs` is the GitHub
  dialect half: `verify_sig256` verifies `X-Hub-Signature-256`
  (`sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 over the **raw request bytes** — unsigned,
  bad-signature, `sha1=`/unsupported-alg all refuse typed);
  `X-GitHub-Delivery` → the namespaced occurrence id;
  `issues`/`issue_comment` payloads → `external{kind:"github.issue"}`
  occurrences carrying `gh-<repo>-<n>` item dossiers;
  `SignedWebhookIngress::receive_github` + `WebhookAdapter::from_doc`'s
  `github` member wire it through the same `accept` tail (CC1).
- **`fleet.webhook_ingress` verifies *and admits*** — the op now observes
  through the same adapter instance inside the call
  (`context.observation.recorded` + `control.wakeup.occurred` durable),
  so a signed delivery reaches `fleet.reconcile` and folds into a
  `WorkItem` (previously the verified occurrence died with the transient
  adapter). Replays answer honestly; the durable fold audits the skip;
  a stale re-delivery admits `known` — one item.
- **`github-live` leg executed** — `scripts/live-verify.sh github-live`
  → `pass` (`hh-live-evidence/1`
  `2026-10-22-github-live.json`, USD 0, endpoint `api.github.com:443`):
  broker-resolved credentials (`LaunchEnv` channels → grant/decide/bind/
  mediate/drain_claim — no value in any artifact); runtime `cloudflared`
  quick tunnel; `GET hooks` pre-state (0) → `POST` hook (id 701473010) →
  `GET issues` pre-state → test issue #2 + comment → signed `issues`
  delivery `received` → `WorkItem gh-SteveVitali-hh-live-sandbox-2`
  `dispatching` → dedupe `observed=0` → stale `observed=1 items=1` →
  `DELETE` hook 204 → verified absent → issue closed +
  `hh-live-test`-labeled (issues are undeletable; recorded). The OOP leg
  spawned the packaged variant `subprocess_confined` over the captured
  snapshot — capability probe + list/get green. Sandbox-only mutations;
  trap-guarded rollback confirmed `nothing-pending`.
- **Leg machinery** — `scripts/live-github.sh` orchestrator (the trap
  runs `r47_github_cleanup` over `state.json`); `live-verify.sh` gains
  the `github-live` registry entry; `crates/hh-embed/tests/r4_7_live.rs`
  carries the three gated cells.
